Card Game

Badalone

Every Badalone pack is nine real patents pulled at random from the entire US patent archive: more than twelve million inventions, from 1836 to last week. A method of swinging on a swing. A hat with a built-in umbrella. The light bulb. Each card shows the original drawing redrawn as a white-on-black blueprint, an absurdity index and the plain-words abstract on the back, and opens the original document in one tap. Rarity is earned by influence: the more later inventions built on a patent, the rarer its card. Named after Il Badalone, Brunelleschi's river barge and the subject of the first patent ever granted (Florence, 1421). No ads, no purchases.

Features

  • Nine random patents per pack, drawn live from 12 million+ inventions
  • Original drawings redrawn as white-on-black blueprints
  • Rarity earned by influence, age and collector numbers
  • An absurdity index and a plain-words abstract for every invention
  • Searchable codex of every patent discovered
  • The first player to find a patent has their name on every copy
  • Friends by code, leaderboard and one-for-one trades; no ads, no purchases

Technologies

Flutter Firebase Cloud Functions Patent data FCM
